sections.markdown:
## E2 — Competitive teardown: stopping rules, special vehicles, headlights, parking and phones
No competitor was reviewed in this pass; names, prices, structure, pedagogy, practice style, praise, complaints and coverage are open (NJ-STOP-TEARDOWN).
Adopt and beat lists stay empty until at least two named, priced competitors are examined from their own store or review pages.
Angle to test later: competitors may drill distances as a flat list; grouping the look-alike distances into confusable pairs could be a beat point once verified.

corpus_stability.reason: The New Jersey Driver Manual prints 2026 on its front cover and a single back-cover code; the identification charts carry one revision note (Revised 4/2026) and the manual says fees are subject to change, with no sign of more than one rewrite per year in the selected pages.
